source.title: Mo100z [26.10] NEW SPLIT !! CHALLENGER BEL'VETH INDEPTH GUIDE UPDATED!!

fields: A strong Taliyah, especially on a crit build, disrupts your kit badly. Never dash inside her minefield or you will be stunned immediately. The game is still winnable, but treat her as a priority threat.

Very hard: her knockup sets up near one-shots and she deals true damage. During her ult she burrows and your E cannot damage her. From level 6 she can burst you, so avoid her knockup and play around her kill threat.
You should beat him; only his fear really bothers you. Just make sure he does not out-farm you or out-pace your clears.
If he gets an early lead he can one-shot you and the game gets hard. If you survive his early pressure, you outscale him.
Whoever gets ahead first tends to win, and you also have the scaling to fall back on.
He brings lots of CC; dodge it and you are fine, but it becomes very hard if you fall behind.
Lots of crowd control, so respect it and choose your fights carefully.
A good combo can one-shot you, but your many dashes make his body slam hard to land unless he Flashes.
A skill matchup. She may invade you, but you can win that one-on-one.
Out-gank him early. Wait out his W defensive stance and avoid his taunt; the crit build works well since you are not stacking attack speed into his thorns.
The author considers him overtuned and a hard counter to you, and recommends banning him every game.
